test.name: A whole search with no single hit ref is handed back with no tool call
test.description: The delegation asks for every hit of log_017 and carries no hitRef. This agent judges one hit per spawn; listing a search's hits and spawning one agent per hit is the research router's "Search-hit review". The agent's routing gate answers `Hand-back: no hit ref` with no tool call. A DIRECT negative graded on its invariant: test_hand_back_names_its_owner (test_universal.py) and test_hand_back_writes_nothing, both gated on hand-back.

input.delegation:
Evaluate all the hits of the full-text search log_017 and tell me which of them are Iram Hyde.

projectPath: <workspace>
target: I1

negative.explanation: A whole search is not one hit. The agent body hands back `Hand-back: no hit ref — …` with no tool call, a line that names no owner, so correct_skill is empty and test_hand_back_names_its_owner asks only for the `Hand-back:` line. Fanning the search out is the research router's job, through its "Search-hit review" section. The scenario holds eleven unextracted log_017 hits, so an agent that evaluated them instead would write rows and fail test_hand_back_writes_nothing.

judge_context: The correct reply is one line, `Hand-back: no hit ref — <the request in one clause>`, and no tool call. Listing the hits, reading any of them, or recording any verdict is a fail.
Brevity is correct. Do not expect a verdict or a summary of the search.
